name: macos-tweaks
title: macOS Tweaks
description: Discover and toggle hidden macOS settings without the Terminal. Browse a curated catalog of defaults write tweaks for Finder, Dock, Screenshots, Animations, and more.
author: Undolog

commands.name: browse-tweaks
commands.title: Browse Tweaks
commands.subtitle: macOS Tweaks
commands.description: Browse and toggle hidden macOS settings by category

commands.name: my-tweaks
commands.title: My Tweaks
commands.subtitle: macOS Tweaks
commands.description: View and manage your modified macOS settings

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Tweaks Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: macOS Tweaks
commands.description: Quick access to your modified tweaks from the menu bar

tools.name: search-tweaks
tools.title: Search Tweaks
tools.description: Find the macOS settings this extension can change, with their current and default values. Use this first to get the id of a tweak before applying or resetting it.

tools.name: get-modified-tweaks
tools.title: Get Modified Tweaks
tools.description: List every macOS setting that currently differs from its system default.

tools.name: apply-tweak
tools.title: Apply Tweak
tools.description: Change a macOS setting to a given value. Asks the user to confirm the change first.

tools.name: reset-tweak
tools.title: Reset Tweak
tools.description: Put a macOS setting back to its system default. Asks the user to confirm first.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
